name: memory_wiki_query
description: Search memory-wiki claims with FTS + salience/freshness scoring.

name: memory_wiki_add_claim
description: Add/update a structured durable claim with visibility and event time.

name: memory_wiki_query_secrets
description: Query safe secret metadata. Plaintext and capability tokens are never returned to the model.

name: memory_wiki_recall_plan
description: Plan which topics/types/secrets should be recalled for a query.

name: memory_wiki_post_task
description: Record a post-task durable summary with changed files, backups, verification and service restarts.

name: memory_wiki_active_dashboard
description: Render/read active operational memory dashboard.

name: memory_wiki_doctor
description: Run diagnostics over schema, FTS, dashboards, backups, secrets, contradictions and recall health.

name: memory_wiki_backup
description: Create a full zip backup of sqlite/pages/dashboards/metadata.

name: memory_wiki_list_backups
description: List memory-wiki backups.

name: memory_wiki_restore
description: Restore memory-wiki from a backup id/path.

name: memory_wiki_add_decision
description: Record an architectural/product decision with rationale and alternatives.

name: memory_wiki_add_mistake
description: Record an anti-regression mistake/lesson with trigger, fix and prevention.

name: memory_wiki_add_project_profile
description: Add/update a project profile: root, purpose, commands, services, notes.

name: memory_wiki_add_task_capsule
description: Record a rich task capsule with intent, plan, files, commands, errors, fixes, verification, followups.

name: memory_wiki_add_entity
description: Add/update entity and aliases for lightweight knowledge graph.

name: memory_wiki_add_relation
description: Add a typed relation edge between entities. Valid predicates: owns, owned_by, runs_on, hosts, depends_on, required_by, uses_provider, authenticated_by, replaces, replaced_by, valid_until, supports, contradicts, related_to. Prefer specific over generic.

name: memory_wiki_graph_query
description: Query lightweight entity graph around an entity/text.

name: memory_wiki_apply_user_correction
description: Capture user correction, supersede/uncertain matching old claims, and add corrected claim.

name: memory_wiki_pack_context
description: Budget-aware recall/context packing with optional Code Shrinker coverage deduplication.

name: memory_wiki_memory_diff
description: Compare recalled memory against supplied verified/current facts before answering; returns confirmed, changed/conflicting and stale/unverified memory.

name: memory_wiki_preference_layer
description: Return prioritized durable user preferences/constraints plus the precedence policy for fresh instructions vs memory.

name: memory_wiki_add_preference_rule
description: Add/update a first-class preference priority rule used by the preference layer.

name: memory_wiki_snapshot
description: Write a human-readable snapshot markdown of active memory.

name: memory_wiki_add_evidence
description: Attach evidence to a claim and refresh it.

name: memory_wiki_update_claim
description: Patch claim fields: claim/topic/status/confidence/salience/freshness.

name: memory_wiki_contradict
description: Record contradiction between two claims.

name: memory_wiki_resolve_contradiction
description: Resolve a contradiction and optionally retire/supersede a claim.

name: memory_wiki_dashboard
description: Return dashboard: counts, topics, stale claims, contradictions, paths.

name: memory_wiki_get_page
description: Read a topic page from the markdown wiki vault.

name: memory_wiki_maintenance
description: Run vault maintenance: rebuild FTS, detect contradictions, render pages, optionally prune low-salience retired claims.

name: memory_wiki_merge_claims
description: Merge duplicate/overlapping claims, keeping one canonical claim and superseding or retiring the rest.

name: memory_wiki_import
description: Import claims/evidence from a memory_wiki_export JSON payload.

name: memory_wiki_curate
description: Suggest or apply cleanup: bad topics, low-quality fragments, duplicate-like claims, and optional pinning.

name: memory_wiki_pin_claim
description: Pin a claim so recall/curation preserve it.

name: memory_wiki_health
description: Audit memory-wiki quality: schema, low-quality fragments, bad topics, raw logs, secret exposure, duplicate-like claims.

name: memory_wiki_evaluate_retrieval
description: Run a golden-query retrieval quality suite for recall/pack_context precision and artifact leakage.

name: memory_wiki_rewrite_claim
description: Rewrite one claim in-place with normalized text/topic/type and quality recomputation.

name: memory_wiki_explain_recall
description: Explain why query returns specific claims.

name: memory_wiki_vacuum
description: Aggressively deduplicate, merge near-duplicates, resolve stale contradiction noise, normalize topics, and optionally apply changes.

name: memory_wiki_review_queue
description: List/approve/reject/rewrite candidate memories before they become durable claims.

name: memory_wiki_lint_claim
description: Lint a candidate memory claim and suggest topic/type/scope rewrites.

name: memory_wiki_why_believe
description: Explain provenance, evidence, trust score and contradictions for a claim.

name: memory_wiki_secret_quarantine
description: List quarantined secret-like memory fields; originals are never returned, only hashes/redacted text.

name: memory_wiki_recent_changes
description: Show memory mutations since N seconds ago.

name: memory_wiki_mark_used
description: Feedback loop: mark recalled claims as useful or not useful.

name: memory_wiki_normalize_topics
description: Suggest/apply topic alias normalization.

name: memory_wiki_immune_scan
description: Scan memory database for quality issues and report findings.

name: memory_wiki_compress_topic
description: Create a synthetic summary claim for a topic and optionally supersede older low-priority claims.

name: memory_wiki_resolve_by_policy
description: Resolve contradiction using policy: prefer_explicit_user, prefer_recent, prefer_verified, prefer_environment_probe.

name: memory_wiki_repair
description: Run targeted self-healing repairs: fts, dashboards, integrity, or all.

name: memory_wiki_audit_log
description: Show recent memory-wiki write/repair/backup/restore audit events.

name: memory_wiki_write_firewall
description: Dry-run or queue a candidate memory through source policy, quality lint, artifact detection and secret firewall before durable write.

name: memory_wiki_mutation_log
description: Return transactional mutation log entries with before/after metadata for undo/audit.

name: memory_wiki_undo_last
description: Undo the last reversible memory mutation or a specific mutation id.

name: memory_wiki_transaction
description: Dry-run/apply a bounded non-atomic batch. Each operation may commit independently; use apply_with_backup and stop_on_error for safer rollback.

name: memory_wiki_compile_topic
description: Compile micro-claims in a topic into a curated structured summary; suggest or apply with superseding of older low-priority claims.

name: memory_wiki_get_project_context
description: Return first-class project profile plus related claims/task capsules/graph context.

name: memory_wiki_source_policy
description: Show ingestion policy and write-firewall decision for a source/candidate.

name: memory_wiki_export_bundle
description: Export a redacted scoped sync bundle for cross-profile/remote memory-wiki import.

name: memory_wiki_import_bundle
description: Import a redacted memory-wiki sync bundle from payload or local path.

name: memory_wiki_journal_status
description: Inspect append-only JSONL journal health, hash chain and recent events.

name: memory_wiki_journal_checkpoint
description: Write a logical JSON checkpoint of SQLite tables for journal-based recovery. Secret values are always excluded.

name: memory_wiki_semantic_status
description: Check embedding (:4000) and Qdrant (:6333) health and point count.

name: memory_wiki_reindex
description: Re-index all active claims into Qdrant vector store.

name: memory_wiki_debug_search
description: Search with full breakdown: FTS rank, vector rank, RRF score per claim.

name: memory_wiki_compare_search
description: Compare FTS-only vs vector-only vs hybrid retrieval.

name: memory_wiki_query_mode
description: Detect query type (technical/semantic/mixed) without searching.

name: memory_wiki_rebuild_from_journal
description: Plan or apply SQLite rebuild from latest logical checkpoint plus append-only JSONL after-events.

name: memory_wiki_export
description: Export bounded claims/evidence/contradictions JSON.

name: memory_wiki_decay_scan
description: Scan claims with exponential decay scoring. Returns stale candidates below threshold.

name: memory_wiki_decay_stats
description: Get decay statistics: total/active/archived claim counts.

name: memory_wiki_decay_archive
description: Archive claims with decay_score below threshold. High-confidence (>=0.7) claims are only flagged, never auto-archived.

name: memory_wiki_gc
description: Garbage collect dead/stale claims: archive claims with low salience and no recent access. Safe with dry_run first.

dry_run.description: If true, only list candidates without archiving

max_age_days.description: Max age in days before a claim is considered stale

name: memory_wiki_federate_merge
description: Merge claims from another memory-wiki instance. Provide remote claims as JSON string.

payload_json.description: JSON string with {claims: [...]} from remote export

name: memory_wiki_summarize_topic
description: Generate a structured summary of a topic with key facts, type breakdown, and open contradictions.

name: memory_wiki_claim_history
description: Show revision history for a specific claim from the BEFORE UPDATE trigger.

claim_id.description: Claim ID to show history for

name: memory_wiki_secrecy_report
description: Report on secrecy_level distribution across active claims and secret index entries.

name: memory_wiki_context_sanitize
description: Sanitize text for safe context injection: strips injection patterns, normalizes whitespace, truncates.

name: memory_wiki_is_social_close
description: Check if text is a social closer (ok, thanks, 👍) that should skip memory search.

name: memory_wiki_document_ingest
description: Parse and index one allowlisted document in an isolated worker. Supports Office/OpenDocument/PDF/text/data formats; no automatic full reindex.

name: memory_wiki_document_scan
description: Recursively discover and incrementally index supported documents below an allowlisted directory.

name: memory_wiki_document_embed_pending
description: Create/reuse embeddings for pending semantic document chunks in a bounded batch.

name: memory_wiki_document_query
description: Hybrid document retrieval: FTS5/BM25 over addressable units and chunks + Qdrant embeddings + weighted RRF + configured reranker.

name: memory_wiki_document_source
description: Show indexed metadata, revision and counts for one document source.

name: memory_wiki_document_unit_context
description: Return neighbouring addressable document units around an anchor or unit ID.

name: memory_wiki_document_neighbors
description: Traverse structural and formula/reference edges around a document anchor.

name: memory_wiki_document_status
description: Show indexed document sources, parser capabilities and pending embedding counts.

name: memory_wiki_document_delete
description: Soft-delete a document graph and archive its active embedding claims.

name: memory_wiki_document_ingest_inbox
description: Consume bounded document manifests emitted by Code Shrinker from the shared inbox.

name: memory_wiki_code_graph_status
description: Show indexed repositories and counts for files, symbols, semantic chunks, addressable lines, edges and embedded chunks.

name: memory_wiki_code_graph_embed_pending
description: Create/reuse semantic claims for pending code chunks in a bounded batch. Repeat until pending_after is zero; no full reindex is started.

name: memory_wiki_code_graph_query
description: Hybrid code retrieval: FTS5/BM25 over symbols/chunks/lines + Qdrant semantic chunks + weighted RRF + configured reranker + graph-neighbour boost.

name: memory_wiki_code_line_context
description: Return redacted addressable lines around line_id or repository/file/line, with owning symbols and chunks. Escalate to Code Shrinker file.lines for exact source.

name: memory_wiki_code_graph_neighbors
description: Traverse typed code-graph edges around a symbol/node for up to three hops.

name: memory_wiki_code_graph_ingest_inbox
description: Consume pending Code Shrinker patch and code_graph_snapshot events from the shared inbox.

name: memory_wiki_code_claim_add
description: Add/update a code-linked claim with repository/symbol/revision metadata. Repository, file_path, and content_hash required.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of symbol or file content

source_event_id.description: Durable producer event identifier for exactly-once ingestion

name: memory_wiki_code_claim_query
description: Query code-linked claims by repository/symbol/file criteria.

name: memory_wiki_symbol_history
description: Get repository-scoped revision history for a code symbol.

name: memory_wiki_repository_context
description: Return all code-linked claims for a repository.

name: memory_wiki_invalidate_revision
description: Mark code claims stale after symbol/file change — scoped by repository. Requires symbol_id or file_path.

new_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA after the change

new_content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the new file or symbol content

name: memory_wiki_patch_outcome_add
description: Record the outcome of a patch application with structured validation and revision metadata.
